title: Concurrent stdin pipe streaming and storage-only susi-distill tag discovery in susi-harness git_governor
goal: Fix >64 KB OS pipe buffer deadlock when git cat-file --batch inspects large .agents/tasks ledgers by streaming stdin concurrently via std::thread::scope in run_git, and teach promote_release_candidate to fetch and audit storage-only refs/tags/susi-distill/* snapshot tags (including legacy-release-* tags after T-CODEXSTORAGEONLY-1) while ranking semver vX.Y.Z candidates ahead of ad-hoc date RCs.

results.tests: susi-harness --lib: 528 passed / 0 failed (git_governor 4/4 incl. 160-file >640 KB .agents/tasks pipe-deadlock + susi-distill/legacy-release-* tag discovery + semver ranking); susi-harness --bins: 41 passed / 0 failed
results.guards: lean_core_ceilings 2/2 (susi-harness src = 37,393 lines vs ceiling 37,439), architecture_tests 43/43, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5/5, no_github_coupling 5/5, orphan_sources 3/3, task_records 3/3

limitations: promote_release_candidate promotes verified susi-distillation-receipt-v1 candidates to local-only refs/heads/release/<name> and create-only refs/tags/susi-distill/<name>; final vX.Y.Z production tags continue to require exact-tree release-qualify on both x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.
